verdict.rationale: The GitHub repo documents an open-source branch, published as a prebuilt GitHub Container Registry image that bundles headless Chrome, LibreOffice and CJK fonts, so developers can run Reader themselves without building it. It also supports pointing Reader at an S3-compatible bucket for caching. The residential/datacenter proxy pool, however, is explicitly SaaS-only and requires a key. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license, documentation of feature parity between the open-source branch and the hosted service, detailed deployment/configuration docs, and independent hands-on reports of self-hosting.
